Mara Reedheart — level 1

The grove healer who can become the beast defending it.

Human Shepherd · HP 18/18 · Grit 2/2 · Speed 7 squares · Bulk 7/10.

Languages: Common and Reed Speech (an ordinary regional language). See the @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b65e9644d24629f2.JournalEntryPage.0237eee3512bbfa9]{language reference}.

Attributes and ancestry

BrawnFortitudeAgilityGuileKnowledgeReason
+0+1+0+0+0+2

Total +3. Shepherd minima: Reason, Guile ≥ 0; met. Mental sum +2, so each stage’s base pool is 12 DP.

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.842bdbfabf5a03a8.JournalEntryPage.245562163cefc790]{Road in the Blood}: Base Speed +1. Long journeys remain ordinary travel; this creates no exhaustion rule. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.049752f9959c6e53.JournalEntryPage.c17d086cf4b23a5f]{Make Room at the Fire}: Once per scene, when you offer genuine food, shelter or shared work to a nonhostile person, gain 1 Boon to the next Guile roll seeking ordinary hospitality or trust from them before the scene ends. No automatic friendship or compelled response.

Level 1 — class and purchases

Choose @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.9f89a95738256790.JournalEntryPage.0577d987ea27d2c6]{Shepherd}. Class grants Life 1 and Medicine 1; 1 duplicate(s) give +1 DP, not higher ranks. Free signature: @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.12fc0ae8f9dfe1e6.JournalEntryPage.9c8d697ba5d2b312]{Gentle Return}. Its use procedure follows; the linked card remains the complete reference:

Action: Passive · Attribute: None — no roll

Target / range / shape: One willing ally you have just restored HP to with a spell or potion.

That ally may stand without spending movement, then move 1 square without provoking if able. This works even if it was above 0 HP before healing. It grants no extra HP, reduces no healing payment and cannot reverse Last Words.

Duration: Immediate stand and movement after healing.

Equipment / acquisition: None.

Signature limit: Once on your turn; the ally must actually regain HP.

Fresh pool: 12 + 1 = 13 DP. All discipline purchases below occur before cards that need them.

Final disciplines: Life 1, Medicine 1, Radiance 1, Wilderness 1.

Equipment and derived statistics

No mechanical equipment is granted by these ability choices. Market purchases are listed below. Ordinary appearance/clothing is descriptive; no armor, weapon, focus, tools or adventuring supplies are assumed.

HP: 12 + ancestry 2 + class 3 + Fortitude 1 + trait 0 + Conditioned Body 0 = 18. Capacity: 10 + 3 × Brawn (0) = 10. Granted Bulk 0 + purchased Bulk 7 = 7, so encumbrance penalty 0. Speed: ancestry 6 + Agility 0 + trait 1 = 7.

Physical resistance: 0. Other resistances: 0. Wounds and death marks: 0. Grit: 2. No HP or Grit has been spent during creation.

Starting coins and market purchases are resolved in the shopping ledger below. Card-granted equipment is not purchased again. Repeated compatible weapon/tool grants supply no duplicates.

Recipes: none granted or purchased.

At the table

Sap and Breath pays 1 HP before healing 3/5/7 HP; Mara must remain above zero and have a free hand. Gentle Return adds the printed recovery movement once on her turn. Roots Remember Feet controls ground, while Borrow the Beast provides close fighting at the cost of spellcasting, speech and item use. Returning costs a Maneuver, so healing and beast fighting are a real choice. No potion or herb supply is silently granted.

Complete learned-card checklist

These are all origin grants, purchases and the free signature; there is no equipped-card limit. Universal references are supplied separately.

Their equipment and situation requirements still apply.
